result.summary: Refactors ZMQ initialization to return a util::Result with detailed failure messages across notifier setup, socket options, and binding. Propagates initialization failures to AppInitMain so that bitcoind logs an error and aborts startup via InitError if any configured ZMQ notifier fails to initialize.
result.problem: When a node operator configures -zmqpub* options and a socket fails to bind (such as when the port is already taken or the address is invalid), bitcoind logs only to the debug log and continues running without ZMQ notifications. The operator is left unaware that notifications are disabled.
evidence: Issue #33715 reported that binding failures when a port was in use were swallowed in debug logs, allowing bitcoind to start while getzmqnotifications showed nothing and the user was unaware.
The PR resurrects inactive PR #33727 to fulfill agreement from maintainers on #33715 that ZMQ bind failures should log loudly and abort startup.
result.card: Bitcoin Core aborts startup with an explicit error message if any configured ZMQ notification socket fails to initialize or bind. Currently, if an operator configures -zmqpub* and binding fails due to an invalid address or an occupied port, bitcoind proceeds silently and only logs at debug level, leaving the operator unaware that ZMQ is inactive. Issue #33715 documented this silent failure when ports were already in use. Nodes without ZMQ options configured are unaffected.
